description: Defines an abstract class for handling VAST inline banner types in an ad server plugin, including form building, validation, and processing methods, as well as external dependencies and class structure.

classes.name: Plugins_BannerTypeHTML_vastInlineBannerTypeHtml_vastBase
classes.description: Abstract class for managing VAST inline banner ad types, including form handling, validation, and ad data processing.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the media content type, which is 'html'.

methods.name: getStorageType
methods.description: Returns the storage type, which is 'html'.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form for ad configuration, adding error message if form is submitted.

methods.name: preprocessForm
methods.description: Prepares form data before saving, serializing VAST parameters into the database.

methods.name: processForm
methods.description: Saves or updates ad data into the database, including VAST element details.

methods.name: getExtendedBannerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves additional banner info from the database and merges it with existing banner data.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Performs custom validation on form fields after submission, including required fields and video type/delivery validation.

methods.name: getPossibleCompanions
methods.description: Returns a list of compatible companion banners for the ad, excluding VAST types.

methods.name: getAllFieldsLabels
methods.description: Provides labels for all form fields related to VAST video configuration.

methods.name: getFieldLabel
methods.description: Returns the label for a specific form field.

methods.name: addFormRequiredElement
methods.description: Adds a form element and marks it as conditionally required based on other field values.

methods.name: getLabelWithRequiredStar
methods.description: Appends a red asterisk to a label to indicate required fields.

methods.name: setElementIsRequired
methods.description: Marks a form element as required based on other field values.

methods.name: addVastParametersToForm
methods.description: Adds hidden fields and URL fields for VAST parameters to the form.

methods.name: addThirdPartyImpressionTracking
methods.description: Adds impression tracking URL input to the form.

methods.name: addVastCompanionsToForm
methods.description: Adds a dropdown for selecting companion banners, with campaign type checks.

methods.name: addVastHardcodedDimensionsToForm
methods.description: Sets fixed width and height for the banner and adds hidden fields.

methods.name: addIntroductionInlineHelp
methods.description: Adds help text and instructions for setting up the ad type.

methods.name: addVastVideoUrlFields
methods.description: Adds URL input fields and radio buttons for streaming vs progressive delivery, with associated JavaScript.
